decisive_items: using serial doses of nonionic iodinated contrast (Iopromide) totaling 3 mL/kg over 30 minutes
Approximately 12 hours after the procedure, the patient developed clonic movements of the left upper limb and persistent sucking motions
a slight diffuse increase in cortical density predominantly in the right frontal, parietal, and occipital lobes
response.rationale: The temporal relationship between intra-arterial contrast administration and the onset of focal seizures, combined with the characteristic noncontrast CT finding of diffuse cortical hyperdensity (contrast extravasation), strongly supports contrast-induced encephalopathy over hypoxic-ischemic injury or vasculopathy.

rejected.why: No evidence of chronic vascular disease; acute onset after contrast administration is not consistent with a vasculopathy.
The CT finding of diffuse cortical hyperdensity is not typical of hypoxic-ischemic injury, and the temporal relationship to contrast administration is more compelling.
